title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan and Pandian launch a car brokerage, receiving Cheran's support. Nadesan brings food for Nila, who Chozhan credits for turning him into a responsible person.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi clears Malar and Mathi, taking the blame for the movie plan while Ragavan agrees to the outing. After clashing, Suresh boasts of his success, and Mathi appreciates him.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 64: Who Controls the House Now?
description: A midnight siren shocks the house as a new Junior BB is elected and a fresh leader takes charge. Later, mixed nominations ignite explosive drama between Mukesh and Muthazhagi.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Nesan confirms Perumatha's and Vellathai's eyesight post-surgery. Further, Vellathai thanks Tamizhselvi and asks to take her home.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu confides in Arjun about Shyam's marriage pressure, and he comforts her. She confesses her love for Arjun, expressing her wish to return his unconditional affection.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani loses confidence in winning the expo after spotting Maha among the judges. Later, Vennila asks Maha to ensure Kanmani's defeat, promising to return home to her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Azhagappan and Sumathi turn Abhi away for eloping with Shanmugam. Abhi reaches Kandhasamy's home, while Azhagappan is shocked to discover his valuable land.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Muthuvel proposes hosting Gomathi's family for lunch. Pandian is surprised by the wedding night decorations as Thangamayil, Raji, and Meena send Gomathi to join him.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj agrees to safeguard Devika's unaccounted cash and jewellery, tempted by her wealth. Muthu proves his cleverness by stumping Manoj with a tricky question and winning the bet.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri's poster celebrating Abinaya becoming a lawyer makes her happy. However, she grows anxious as people gossip about her past life in jail.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar shows his dedication to farming for his parents. Meanwhile, Poongodi and Thenmozhi take charge of the household and cooking in Meenatchi's absence.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ganthimathi and Kumaresan have Sidharth arrested for his drunken misconduct. Kalamma confronts them angrily, only for Ilamathi to expose her role in Ashok's murder.
